otherWarningsReviewed: pages: pages.support.26 mostly uses a different script
pages: pages.tokushoho.1 is 4.4x the English length
pages: pages.shikin-kessai.1 is 4.6x the English length
notes: Generated names are compounds with indefinite second parts (generatedNames: compound): Torden + top = Tordentop, Jern + port = Jernport.
The Japanese statutory titles expand into Danish explanations; long page headings wrap.

Nothing attaches to a placeholder: no definite ending or genitive s (By: {name}, bygningen {building}); tests/locales/danish.test.ts checks it, and the check refuses Norwegian spellings (igjen, enhet, kjøpe, etter).
Actual player names, authored chat, technical IDs (IndexedDB, productId, enum values such as delete or reject) and provider-owned sheets are outside automatic translation.
No native Danish speaker has reviewed this translation yet, nor the legal pages; that review remains a release step.
